item.title: Crookston 3rd grade girls basketball wins the DGF Tournament in their first ever tourney
item.description: The Crookston third-grade girls’ basketball team played in its first-ever tournament and won the championship at the Dilworth-Glyndon-Felton Winter Blast tournament. Crookston started the tournament with a 24-8 victory over East Grand Forks. In the semifinals, the girls battled Moorhead in a thrilling, back-and-forth matchup, pulling out a hard-fought 22–18 win.
